item.title: AUD/JPY retreats to 104.50 after hitting 17-month highs
item.description: AUD/JPY halts its five-day winning streak. The currency cross is trading around 104.50 after pulling back from 104.72, the highest level since July 2024, reached during the early Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar reaches fresh 14-month highs as US Dollar stalls recovery
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) advances against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, continuing its winning streak for the third successive session.

item.title: USD/INR ticks up as FIIs continue to offload stake in Indian stock market
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) ticks down against the US Dollar (USD) in the early trading session on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair edges higher to near 90.16, but is broadly in the corrective phase, following the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) intervention last week.

item.title: GBP/JPY hangs near weekly low, around mid-210.00s amid a broadly firmer JPY
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross attracts some sellers for the second straight day on Wednesday and trades around mid-210.00s, closer to the weekly trough during the Asian session. Spot prices, however, remain within striking distance of the highest level since August 2008, touched on Monday.

item.title: Japanese Yen remains on the front foot vs. bearish USD amid BoJ-Fed policy divergence
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) prolongs its uptrend against a broadly weaker US Dollar (USD) for the third straight day and climbs to a fresh weekly top during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD extends bull run to near $72.70 as Fed dovish bets remain steady
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) rallies further to near $72.70 during the early European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/GBP weakens below 0.8750 as BoE hints at slower easing pace
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross trades in negative territory for the fifth consecutive day around 0.8725 during the early European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD strengthens to around 1.3510 early European session
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory near 1.3510 during the early European session on Wednesday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) strengthens against the Greenback on expectations that the Bank of England (BoE) will follow a gradual monetary easing path in 2026.

item.title: Gold eases from record high amid profit-taking
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) eases from a record high of $4,526 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday as traders book some profits. Additionally, the upbeat US Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data might also weigh on the Gold price.
